bullets: Hair transplants (FUT strip or FUE punch method)
Surgical procedures (dermatological, neurosurgical)
Head injuries or trauma (accidents, falls, blows)
Cosmetic treatments (e.g. poorly performed SMP)

sections.title: HOW DOES SMP FOR SCARS WORK?
bullets: Covers the contrast between the scar and surrounding skin
Blends the color and texture with the surrounding scalp
Effect: scar becomes visually invisible even up close
text: Scalp micropigmentation uses special pigment and a micro needle to conceal and visually neutralize the scar:
Treatment can be done even if hair is present (e.g. after FUE in the donor area)

image.alt: Before and after SMP treatment for transplant scar

sections.title: SCARS AFTER TRANSPLANT – FUE and FUT
bullets: Small circles/dots, often multiple, in the donor area. Become visible if hair is cut short.
A single horizontal line, clearly visible when the head is shaved.
Perfect solution for men who want to wear short hairstyles
Visually conceals the scar without surgery
text: Can be performed even after unsuccessful transplants

sections.title: WHAT DOES THE TREATMENT LOOK LIKE?
bullets: 2–3 sessions, spaced 7–14 days apart
No downtime – you can resume activities the next day
Adjusted based on skin type and scar age
text: Pigment is carefully applied in layers, without irritation or pain.

image.alt: How pigment covers the scar on the scalp

list.q: Can SMP completely hide a scar?
list.a: Visually yes – physically no. The pigment covers color and contrast differences.
No, sterile technique and light pressure are used. The treatment is safe and painless.

list.q: How long does the effect last?
list.a: 2–4 years, after which a touch-up can be done.

list.q: Can SMP be done if I have multiple scars?
list.a: Yes – we evaluate each case individually.
